DATA PROCESSING AGREEMENT

This Data Processing Agreement supplements the Master Services Agreement
between Vector Consulting LLC ("Processor") and Northgate Retail Group
("Controller").

1. Scope. Processor shall process personal data only on documented
instructions from Controller, including with regard to transfers, unless
required to do otherwise by applicable law, in accordance with the Data
Protection Act (2018) and applicable law.

2. Security. Processor shall ensure the system logs all access to
personal data and retains those logs for at least twelve months. The
system must enforce role-based access control for every user account.

3. Sub-processors. Processor shall not engage a sub-processor without
Controller's prior written authorization and shall impose the same data
protection obligations on any authorized sub-processor.

4. Breach Notification. Processor shall notify Controller without undue
delay, and in any case within 48 hours, after becoming aware of a personal
data breach affecting Controller's data.

5. Audit Rights. Controller may audit Processor's compliance with this
Agreement once per year on reasonable prior notice.
